verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Convex's reactive query model (queries automatically re-run when underlying data changes) and HTTP endpoints for calling functions, but there is no mention of user-definable rules, triggers, cron jobs, or scheduled/event-driven actions that a user could configure to fire automatically on arbitrary events. Missing for 10: any documentation of scheduled functions, cron/triggers, or a rule-definition mechanism for automated actions on events.
